findings.summary: closeMenu() removes the keydown listener but never calls document.removeEventListener('click', onClickOutside), even though the brief explicitly requires cleaning up the outside-click listener once the menu closes. The listener is added once in openMenu (line 63) and never torn down, so it stays attached to `document` permanently after the first time the menu is ever opened. Once the menu closes by any means (Escape, toggle click, or this new outside-click handler itself), every subsequent click anywhere on the page re-invokes onClickOutside; since the menu is closed, `!menuEl.contains(target) && !toggleEl.contains(target)` is true for virtually any click, so closeMenu() fires again — whose last line unconditionally calls `toggleEl.focus()`. Net effect: after the mobile menu is opened once, focus gets silently yanked to the hamburger toggle button on every subsequent click on the page for the rest of that page's lifetime. This is precisely the failure mode the brief names.

findings.summary: The implementer's report claims "Tests for the change were written and run," but the diff only touches Nav.astro (10 insertions, 0 test files), and the repo has no test runner at all — no `test` script in package.json, no vitest/playwright/jest, no *.spec.*/*.test.* files anywhere in the tree. The testing claim is unsubstantiated and appears false rather than merely incomplete.
